cases.prompt: We're adding invoice creation (validator, service, server action, page). Set up the tests first.
expected: Pyramid table maps each acceptance criterion to unit/integration/e2e with file paths and fixtures
Negative cases included: invalid input, viewer forbidden, cross-tenant, duplicate number
Tests written and run red before implementation; full suite run after green
Only I/O boundaries mocked; service under test not mocked

cases.prompt: This repo has no vitest or playwright. Add testing for the login flow.
expected: Scaffolds vitest.config.ts, playwright.config.ts, tests/setup.ts, auth.setup.ts from assets without overwriting anything existing
Login e2e uses accessible selectors and storageState, no waitForTimeout
Asks once for the feature/change and its acceptance criteria
